exclusions.source_text: Serum aspartate aminotransferase/serum glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase (AST/SGOT) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT/SGPT) ≤3x upper limit of normal (ULN).
Serum total bilirubin \<1.5x ULN. Higher levels are acceptable if these can be attributed to ineffective erythropoiesis or Gilbert's syndrome.
Creatinine clearance greater than 40 mL/min based on the Cockcroft-Gault glomerular filtration rate estimation.
Concurrent primary malignancy requiring active cytotoxic chemotherapy and/or ionizing radiation therapy.
Hypersplenism and/or evidence of portal hypertension on physical exam or imaging.
